name: 宠物除臭消毒喷雾蓝净款
description: 蓝调清爽详情页套图：首屏卖点、功能图标、痛点放大、护理场景、微距与参数收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless studio backdrops alternating pure white #FFFFFF sections and soft sky-blue #6FA8DC bands with rounded pale-blue #C9DFF2 info cards
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused daylight, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, airy clean mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless studio backdrop only, no hard tabletop, products grounded by soft contact shadow
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, bold rounded headlines in #2D2D2D or #FFFFFF with lemon-yellow #F2D22E highlighter underline, short labels only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular outline icons, 2px stroke, flat single-color white or deep blue #4A7EBB
styleLock.presentationRules: bottle upright centered or offset-left at stable scale, pet companion seated at right, consistent 3/4 hero angle across scenes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean pet-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, soft sky blue #6FA8DC, pale blue panel #C9DFF2, one lemon-yellow highlighter accent #F2D22E, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D; cool temperature; seamless studio backdrops alternating white sections and rounded blue panels; bright soft diffused daylight with front-left key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with yellow highlighter underline; thin-line circular outline icons with 2px stroke; stable product scale with upright bottle placement and pet companion at right; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 由 8 片 800x1200 详情页长图切片（_sources/宠物用品 (20)/panels）提炼。已剥离：源品牌与产地「广西柳泉」、「清除99%细菌」等功效承诺词、二维码会员水印、具体功效词（抑菌/止痒/驱虫等），全部替换为 {callout}/{selling_point} 占位符；源瓶身为无标白瓶，产品统一以 {product} 占位。品类判定以图片内容为准：宠物消毒液/除臭喷雾，L2 取「清洁」，与库内已有清洁类模版（分层猫砂盆）以 leaf「宠物除臭消毒喷雾」区分（环境除味消毒定位）。源夹名「宠物用品」为泛称 L1，与实际品类一致，无需纠正。假设：panel-08 参数表部分文字被二维码遮挡，「产品功效」行按可见片段推断为毛发清洁柔顺类描述并已占位化；panel-02 标题「产品选好 生活困扰」疑为源图文案笔误，未采用。库内尚无同类消毒/除臭模版，id 无冲突。
